content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-85. - Execution; district designated; signatures.
content.summary:
Any bond shall be executed in the name of and on behalf of the city, shall bear the
               designation of the district and shall be signed as provided by the council.
(Code 1981, § 27-86; Ord. No. 551, § 29(H), 5-14-1964)
